title: Microsoft Purview eDiscovery: HTML conversion and keyword search for Loop and Copilot Pages files
notes: claim 57: severity major on a rationale: impact rating lowered to minor; ratings are judgements and cannot hold a page
summary: The conversion controls, defaults, licensing and roadmap facts are supported. Two descriptive statements need narrowing: Microsoft does not explicitly say that skipping conversion produces no keyword hits or that end users see nothing change. The Customer Key discussion should acknowledge conflicting Learn guidance.

claims.claim: eDiscovery can convert .loop and .page files to HTML when adding them to a review set.
claims.quote: Select this option to convert supported cloud-native file formats, such as `.loop` and `.page` files (used by Copilot Notebook and Page content), to HTML when adding items to the review set.

claims.claim: Converted content is indexed and available for keyword search in the review set.
claims.quote: Converted content is indexed and available for keyword search in the review set, making it easier to review and analyze.

claims.claim: Review-set exports can convert supported .loop and .page files to HTML in the export package.
claims.quote: Convert supported file formats to HTML: This option converts supported cloud-native file formats, such as `.loop` and `.page` files (used by Copilot Notebook and Page content), to HTML during export.

claims.claim: The stated Purview route through Cases, Searches, Add to review set, an existing review set and the ODSP section reaches Convert supported file formats to HTML.
claims.quote: Select a search on the Searches tab, and then select Add to review set. On the Add items to review set flyout, select Add to a new review set or Add to an existing review set.

claims.claim: POST /v1.0/security/cases/ediscoveryCases/{eDiscoveryCaseId}/reviewSets/{eDiscoveryReviewSetId}/addToReviewSet adds search content to a review set and accepts additionalDataOptions.
claims.quote: POST https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/security/cases/ediscoveryCases/58399dff-cebe-478f-b1af-d3227f1fd645/reviewSets/63ef0fd7-0db2-45eb-a9d7-7d75c8239873/addToReviewSet

claims.where: controls[0].note; Governance guidance: At rollout; Governance controls
claims.claim: The additionalDataOptions enum has a cloudNativeHtmlConversion value for HTML conversion during review-set collection.
claims.quote: cloudNativeHtmlConversion | Convert items to cloud-native HTML format during review set collection.

claims.claim: The addToReviewSet action's parameter table does not list cloudNativeHtmlConversion, although its linked resource reference does.
claims.quote: Searched: cloudNativeHtmlConversion in the opened v1.0 addToReviewSet action and ediscoveryAddToReviewSetOperation resource. The action lists nine additionalDataOptions values without it; the linked resource explicitly lists it.

claims.claim: The resource documents cloudNativeHtmlConversion as an evolvable enum member returned with Prefer: include-unknown-enum-members.
claims.quote: Use the Prefer: include-unknown-enum-members request header to get the following values from this evolvable enum: advancedIndexing, listAttachments, htmlTranscripts, messageConversationExpansion, locationsWithoutHits, allItemsInFolder, cloudNativeHtmlConversion.

claims.claim: The stated route through Cases, Review sets, All items, Action, Export and Export items with item report reaches the HTML conversion option.
claims.quote: Select the review set that you want to export and select the All items tab. In the review set, select the items to export. Select Action > Export on the command bar.
claims.fix: Include the omitted item-selection step: 'eDiscovery > Cases > case > Review sets > review set > All items > items > Action > Export > Export type > Export items with item report > Convert supported file formats to HTML', as documented at https://learn.microsoft.com/purview/edisc-review-set-export.

claims.claim: No automation option for HTML conversion during a review-set export is documented, and Graph exportOptions lists no such value.
claims.quote: Searched: eDiscovery review set export HTML conversion Graph exportOptions cloudNativeHtmlConversion PowerShell. Read reviewSet export v1.0, export-operation v1.0 and beta, and Graph PowerShell search excerpts; no HTML-conversion export option was documented.

claims.where: controls[2].ui and api; What's changing; Open questions
claims.claim: Learn documents no .loop or .page HTML conversion control for exports from search in either the portal instructions or Graph exportResult options.
claims.quote: Searched: eDiscovery export search results loop page Convert supported file formats HTML exportResult. Read the full search-export page and exportResult parameter table; neither documents this control. Search results describe conversion for review sets, not search exports.

claims.where: Why it matters; Scope; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: A Copilot Page is a .page file stored in SharePoint, OneDrive or SharePoint Embedded.
claims.quote: A Copilot Page is a shareable `.page` file. ... A file stored in SharePoint, OneDrive, or SharePoint Embedded, similar to how a Word document is stored.

claims.claim: eDiscovery treats a Copilot Page as a collaborative document rather than an email or Teams message.
claims.quote: A collaborative document, not a form of electronic communication such as an email or Teams message.

claims.claim: Copilot Pages can be collected and exported in their original .page format without HTML conversion.
claims.quote: Microsoft Purview eDiscovery supports collecting and exporting Copilot Pages in their original format.

claims.claim: Downloaded .page files do not open directly in the native Copilot Pages experience.
claims.quote: Downloaded `.page` files don't open directly in the native Copilot Pages experience. To view a supported file in its native experience, upload it to OneDrive, and then open it from there.

claims.claim: Adding Pages to a review set without conversion produces no keyword hits in those files.
claims.quote: Searched: eDiscovery Loop page HTML conversion keyword search without conversion; "eDiscovery" "Loop" "keyword" "conversion". Read Copilot Pages, add-to-review-set and supported-file-type excerpts; none explicitly states that unconverted Pages produce no keyword hits.
claims.fix: Replace 'a team that doesn't know about the option may add Pages to a review set without conversion and get no keyword hits in them' with 'a team that does not know about the option may miss the documented conversion workflow that indexes Page content for keyword search'.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Governance controls
claims.claim: Reviewer provides read-only review-set access in cases where the user is a member.
claims.quote: Reviewer. Provides read-only access to review sets within eDiscovery cases where the user is a member. Reviewers can view and tag documents but cannot perform other case management tasks.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Case membership and eDiscovery roles govern access to converted content in review sets.
claims.quote: This role lets users access review sets in eDiscovery. Users who are assigned this role can see and open the list of cases that they're members of. After the user accesses an eDiscovery case, they can select Review sets to access case data.

claims.where: Why it matters; Risk assessment: Data exposure
claims.claim: HTML conversion is useful for post-export workflows that support HTML but lack tooling for native cloud file formats.

claims.claim: Review-set export content must be downloaded within 30 days after the export process completes.
claims.quote: However, you must download the content from an export process within 30 days after the export process completes.

claims.claim: Review-set content is copied to Microsoft-managed Azure Storage dedicated to the case.
claims.quote: When you add content to a review set, the items and their metadata are copied to a Microsoft-managed Azure Storage location dedicated to the case.

claims.claim: Customer Key encrypts review-set content at rest when the tenant is configured with Customer Key.
claims.quote: Does Customer Key apply to review set content? | Yes. If your tenant is configured with Customer Key, review set content at rest is encrypted with the customer-managed key.
claims.fix: Append: 'The Learn search-export page's CMK direct-export preview section differs: it says, "Data at rest in an eDiscovery review set isn't included at this time." Confirm the applicable protection before relying on it.' Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/purview/edisc-search-export#enable-cmk-customer-managed-key-for-direct-exports-preview.

claims.claim: eDiscovery supports decrypting Pages protected by supported Microsoft encryption technologies.
claims.quote: Microsoft Purview eDiscovery supports decrypting Pages protected by supported Microsoft encryption technologies.

claims.claim: The reviewer must have the RMS Decrypt role for that decryption.
claims.quote: The reviewer must have the RMS Decrypt role.

claims.claim: Decryption support varies by eDiscovery tier.
claims.quote: Decryption support varies by eDiscovery tier, encryption configuration, and where encryption was applied.

claims.claim: Selecting a user's OneDrive does not include their Copilot Pages or Notebooks; their SharePoint Embedded container must be included separately.
claims.quote: Selecting a user's OneDrive as a data source doesn't include their Copilot Pages or Copilot Notebooks. Include the user's SharePoint Embedded container as a separate data source.

claims.claim: Adding SharePoint items to a review set or exporting them might record a FileAccessed audit event.
claims.quote: When you add SharePoint items to a review set or export them from eDiscovery, a FileAccessed audit event might be recorded in the Microsoft 365 audit log.

claims.fix: Replace the impact rationale with 'Low. The documented conversion options are in eDiscovery add-to-review-set and review-set export workflows.'

Read conversion instructions and Loop compliance summary; conversion names supported formats such as .loop and .page, not exhaustive component coverage.

claims.claim: Preservation of version and authorship metadata within the converted HTML copy is not explicitly documented.
